{{Quote|Team Enemy Mine ready.|Trey Courser|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Team Enemy Mine''' was the name given to two members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to prove Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s corruption<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Trey Courser]] and [[Drikall Bessarah]] were tasked with planting the unconscious [[Ledina Chott]], a famous local [[Musician/Legends|singer]] whom they had kidnapped, inside the [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]] building in [[Kura City]]. Their goal was to draw in the [[Kura City Guard]], who could locate the Chott through the tracker inside her ring and frame Thaal for her kidnapping.<ref name="MK" />

The two Wraiths entered the building with Courser wearing a [[neoglith masquer]] with the image of Thaal, easily fooling the building's [[Unidentified Pop-Dog clerk|guard]], who let them in. After leaving Chott deep inside the base, the Wraiths made their escape.<ref name="MK" />
